data.exact_reserve_text: An overall strengthening of prior year's provisions for claims during the year of approximately GBP 0.3m (2013: release of GBP 32.3m) was primarily driven by the adverse experience on the Public Liability accounts in Third party liability, strengthening of GBP 20.8m (2013: strengthening of GBP 9.2m). This is offset by the favourable experience on Marine aviation and transport GBP 14.8m (2013: release of GBP 32.6m), Fire and other damage to property GBP 3.6m (2013: release of GBP 5.6m) and Pecuniary loss GBP 2.2m (2013: release of GBP 3.3m).
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1209 experienced an overall strengthening of prior year claims provisions by GBP 0.3 million in 2014. This was primarily driven by adverse development on Public Liability accounts within Third Party Liability, which strengthened by GBP 20.8 million. This adverse movement was largely offset by favourable development across Marine Aviation and Transport (GBP 14.8 million release), Fire and Other Damage to Property (GBP 3.6 million release), and Pecuniary Loss (GBP 2.2 million release).
raw_causal_phrases: overall strengthening of prior year's provisions for claims
adverse experience on the Public Liability accounts in Third party liability
favourable experience on Marine aviation and transport
Fire and other damage to property

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The sum of individual line of business movements (GBP 0.2m) slightly differs from the overall stated strengthening (GBP 0.3m) in the 'Movement in Prior Year's Provision for Claims' note. The 'Marine aviation and transport' LOB movement was split into 'Marine' and 'Aviation' to align with standard LOB categories, as the report did not provide a separate breakdown.
